observed_in: Stealth and Awareness System design analysis

definition: This dimension controls how long creatures remain aware of the player after detecting them and how quickly their alertness fades over time. Variations can include immediate awareness loss, gradual decay of alertness, or persistent tracking based on player actions.
exclusion_criteria: Immediate return to a neutral state without any awareness retention.
Static awareness that does not change based on player actions or time.
inclusion_criteria: Creatures maintain awareness for a defined duration after an incident.
The rate at which alertness fades can vary based on creature type or environment.
title: Alertness Persistence
